test_initialize: test the HermesACPAgent initialize method returns correct protocol version, agent info, and capabilities
test_authenticate: test the HermesACPAgent authenticate method returns response when provider is configured and None otherwise
test_new_session: test the HermesACPAgent new_session method creates a session with model state and available models
test_cancel_session: test the HermesACPAgent cancel method sets the session cancel event and handles nonexistent sessions gracefully
test_fork_session: test the HermesACPAgent fork_session method creates a new session with a different session id from the original
test_list_sessions: test the HermesACPAgent list_sessions method returns session info with title and updated_at fields
test_set_session_mode: test the HermesACPAgent set_session_mode method updates the session mode and works with the agent router
test_set_session_model: test the HermesACPAgent set_session_model method switches models using provider-prefixed model ids
test_prompt: test the HermesACPAgent prompt method runs the agent, updates history, sends final message, and handles usage tokens
test_slash_commands: test the HermesACPAgent slash command handler for help, model, context, reset, version, compact, and unknown commands
test_register_session_mcp_servers: test the HermesACPAgent _register_session_mcp_servers method registers stdio and http MCP servers and refreshes agent tools
